scheduleNotes.Regionals: TEMPLATE — largest projected Regional under 12-6-1 (356 entries). One list per event; one event per group per day. Platform non-qualifying. Dates follow Season Calendar Stop 1 Option 1 (May 13–16); Option 2 is May 20–23.
scheduleNotes.Zones: TEMPLATE — largest projected Zone under 12-6-1 (486 entries). A/B prelims + final (same day, one board); C/D one list. Zone Open events optional at host discretion. Dates follow Season Calendar Stop 2 Option 1 (Jun 17–20); Option 2 is Jun 24–27.
scheduleNotes.Junior Nationals: DRAFT — 12-6-1. Days 1–4: all Group C/D + all Opens; Days 5–8: Group A/B only. One event per group per day; 3m/platform never on consecutive days; A/B semifinal the day after prelims. Marguerite Aquatic Complex (4×1m, 2×3m, 5/7.5/10m). Window confirmed by host: Jul 26–Aug 8, 2027.
